title: senecio subdentatus
intro: Senecio subdentatus, commonly known as the rough-leaved ragwort, is a perennial plant species belonging to the sunflower family. It is traditionally used for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and alleviating symptoms of respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Senecio subdentatus are attributed to its ability to act as an expectorant and demulcent, helping to soothe and calm irritated tissues in the respiratory tract. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects include sesquiterpene lactones and flavonoids, which have been shown to possess anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties.
